clustering.note: cluster IDs are Leiden-resolution-specific; annotation is marker-driven

annotation.method: per-cell z-score across 12 marker means -> argmax vote (final annotation)
annotation.marker_source: Immune panels = Zhang 2021 (Kim paper lists immune cell type names only, no marker genes); Stromal = Zhang 2021 base + Kim 2022 additions (Fibroblasts += MMP2/PDGFRA/MYL9; Endothelial += PLVAP/KDR/PTPRB); Gastric epithelial = Kim 2022 genes (Enteroendocrine CHGA/GAST/PROX1; Chief PGC) + Parietal GIF/ATP4B/ATP4A (no literature source, data-discovered: per-cluster DEG of Cls 15 misvoted Fibroblasts at 6.3% purity under Zhang 9-type annotation; Kim has no parietal type) + generic gastric mucosa markers (Epithelial panel, LIPF/PGA3/PGA4, GHRL/SST/PCSK1N). Adapted to hg19 ref: T += CD7/LCK/IL32/CCL5 (TRAC/TRBC1 absent from hg19 ref); Plasma = MZB1+SDC1 only (IGHG1/IGKC absent from hg19 ref; JCHAIN present as alias IGJ but 85% detected = ambient RNA; TNFRSF17/DERL3/FKBP11 too global); Fibroblasts -= FAP (dead); Endothelial -= PECAM1 (absent from hg19 ref)
annotation.cd3d_rescue: NK-panel vote + CD3D detected -> T_cells (T-lineage rescue)

rbc.note: applied BEFORE clustering (cluster IDs self-consistent); post-RBC per-cluster globin diagnostics in log (section 6b)
